name: RMIT Student Hardship Assistance Grant
summary: Cash grants of up to $1,000, or vouchers, for RMIT students whose financial difficulty is affecting their study.
key: Cash grants of up to $1,000, or Coles, Myki or Prezzee vouchers.
who: Enrolled for more than one semester.
Experiencing financial difficulty that affects your ability to study, with evidence.
No other funds such as savings or family money available.
how: Complete the Student Hardship Assistance Grant Form with a fortnightly budget, all bank statements and evidence of your circumstances.
catches: Not for first-semester students, students on leave or exchange, or anyone with RMIT fees due or overdue.
Applications without enough evidence are unsuccessful.
